note: Bulk Update Fields registers a core Action plugin (bulk_update_fields_action_base) that mass-updates field values across selected entities through a multi-step confirm form (/admin/bulk_update_fields) and a batch; the actual update is UI/batch driven and has no headless API. Its one persistent, scriptable configuration is bulk_update_fields.settings:exclude — a sequence of field machine names removed from the bulk-update field picker; the exclude form (/admin/bulk_update_fields/exclude) is the module's configure route. Permissions: 'administer bulk_update_fields' plus a mis-spelled 'exlude bulk_update_fields' whose route requires 'exclude bulk_update_fields'. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the exclude config (read it back / write it), verified by reading bulk_update_fields.settings via drush.

evals.prompt: Using the bulk_update_fields module on a Drupal site, how do I set the same value on a field across many nodes at once? Describe the entry point and the action.
evals.expected_output: Go to /admin/content, select the nodes, choose the 'Bulk Update … Fields' action (plugin bulk_update_fields_action_base) and Apply. You are taken to a multi-step form (/admin/bulk_update_fields): pick the field(s), enter the new value, confirm, then a batch writes the values.

evals.prompt: In the bulk_update_fields module, where is the list of fields that are excluded from bulk updates stored (config object and key), and what page edits it?
evals.expected_output: It is stored in the bulk_update_fields.settings config object under the 'exclude' key (a sequence of field machine names). It is edited on the exclude form at /admin/bulk_update_fields/exclude (the module's configure route, bulk_update_fields.bulk_update_exclude_form).

evals.prompt: Which permission does the bulk_update_fields module require to reach its bulk-update form and run the action?
evals.expected_output: The 'administer bulk_update_fields' permission (restrict access: TRUE) gates the update form/action at /admin/bulk_update_fields. (Note: the exclude form's route requires 'exclude bulk_update_fields', but the defined permission key is mis-spelled 'exlude bulk_update_fields'.)

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the bulk_update_fields exclude list has been configured. Inspect the live bulk_update_fields.settings configuration and name a custom field (machine name) that is currently excluded from bulk updates.
evals.expected_output: field_buf_probe_a is in bulk_update_fields.settings:exclude (alongside body). Read it with `drush cget bulk_update_fields.settings exclude`.

evals.prompt: Inspect this site's bulk_update_fields configuration and state exactly which field is currently excluded from the bulk-update field picker.
evals.expected_output: Only field_buf_probe_only is excluded: bulk_update_fields.settings:exclude == ['field_buf_probe_only']. Discoverable via `drush cget bulk_update_fields.settings exclude`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the bulk_update_fields module's configuration to exclude the field 'field_buf_task' from the bulk-update field picker, so it can never be mass-overwritten. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: bulk_update_fields.settings:exclude contains 'field_buf_task' (e.g. set the config key or tick the field on /admin/bulk_update_fields/exclude and save).

evals.prompt: I never want the bulk field updater to touch two of my fields: field_buf_x and field_buf_y. Configure the bulk_update_fields module so both of those fields are excluded from bulk updates, and apply it to the site.
